_what_this_is: Alternative mandates for the same grant. Each scenario is a deployer's sentence and the primitives it wants and refuses; everything else is unstated. The grant never changes; the delta is recomputed per scenario. Written on this site as starting points to be argued with.

scenarios.label: Find and summarise
scenarios.description: Find threads and summarise them. Nothing leaves the mailbox.

scenarios.label: Answer questions about my mail
scenarios.description: What did she say about the invoice? When is the flight?

scenarios.label: A morning digest
scenarios.description: Every morning at eight, what came in overnight.

scenarios.label: Watch for invoices and alert me
scenarios.description: Tell me, by message, when an invoice arrives.

scenarios.label: Draft replies for me
scenarios.description: Read and draft; I press send.

scenarios.label: An inbox agent that sends
scenarios.description: Read, decide, reply, on a schedule, without me.
